Nestlé is the largest nutrition and foods company in the world, originating at their current headquarters in Vevey, Switzerland. Between 1999 and 2005, LEGO released fifty promotional products for Nestlé.

page.overview:
What is Nestlé?

Nestlé is the largest nutrition and foods company in the world, originating at their current headquarters in Vevey, Switzerland. Between 1999 and 2005, LEGO released fifty promotional products for Nestlé.
